payload.consequence: A stated recommendation in the closing recap was reversed in the next turn. The ADR was then written against the repository template, accepted by the maintainer, and added to the ADR index. No artifact was published on the withdrawn recommendation, because the same recap had also offered the ADR as an optional next step.
payload.expected: Applying the skill ADR-worthiness test would yield the same disposition the repository would reach, so the recommendation stated in the closing recap would stand.
payload.observed: The skill supplies a generic three-part test plus a no-existing-home precondition and points to its own ADR-FORMAT reference. This repository records a narrower criterion in docs/adr/README.md and names docs/adr/ADR-TEMPLATE.md as governing. The skill deference rule covers an upstream glossary but not an upstream ADR criterion. Applying the skill test produced considered-not-written, homed in the issue; applying the repository criterion one turn later produced the opposite.
payload.run_condition: One top-level session in companion mode, invoked once from another skill near the end of a design interview. The use handled one glossary file, adding two terms and one relationship line, plus one ADR-warrant disposition. The glossary half completed without deviation. The disposition surfaced at the closing recap and was caught only by a direct user follow-up asking for a determination, not by any step in the skill.
